scenarios.title: Secret keyed docker.io
scenarios.summary: A dockercfg pull secret keyed "docker.io", as kubectl create secret docker-registry --docker-server=docker.io writes it. This is the bug the PR fixes.

scenarios.title: Secret keyed docker.io, without the fix
scenarios.summary: The same secret, with the canonicalizeDockerHubAuth call taken out. docker/cli v29.8.2 then finds nothing for Docker Hub, so func warns that no pull secret was found.
scenarios.note: Before the fix: a copy of this PR with only the canonicalizeDockerHubAuth(cf) line removed. docker/cli is v29.8.2, as after the bump.

scenarios.title: Empty canonical entry (dockerconfigjson)
scenarios.summary: A dockerconfigjson secret with an empty "https://index.docker.io/v1/" entry, as docker login writes it with a credential store, next to docker.io credentials.

scenarios.title: Secret already under the canonical key
scenarios.summary: A secret keyed "https://index.docker.io/v1/", the key docker/cli looks up. Nothing needs copying, so canonicalizeDockerHubAuth returns at once.
